name: LightGBM (Light Gradient Boosting Machine)
description: LightGBM is a gradient boosting framework by Microsoft that uses tree-based learning algorithms. It's designed for distributed and efficient training with optimizations including Gradient-based One-Side Sampling (GOSS) and Exclusive Feature Bundling (EFB). Uses leaf-wise tree growth for faster convergence.

concept.leafWiseGrowth: Grows tree leaf-wise (best-first) vs level-wise; reduces loss faster
concept.histogramBased: Bins continuous features into discrete bins for faster split finding
concept.goss: Gradient-based One-Side Sampling - keeps instances with large gradients
concept.efb: Exclusive Feature Bundling - bundles mutually exclusive features
concept.explanation: Leaf-wise growth builds more complex trees faster than level-wise. Histogram algorithm reduces memory and speeds up splits. GOSS and EFB handle large datasets efficiently without sacrificing accuracy.

avoidWhen: Very small datasets (overfitting risk with leaf-wise)
When exact split points critical (histogram is approximate)

numLeaves.impact: Main complexity control; higher = more overfitting

maxDepth.impact: Limit to prevent overfitting; -1 = no limit

preprocessing: Handle categorical features with categorical_feature parameter
training: Create lgb.Dataset (can be saved to file)
tuning: Use feature_fraction and bagging_fraction for large features
Max_depth can limit tree complexity alongside num_leaves

complexity.timeTraining: O(n × p × log(n) × n_estimators) with histogram optimizations
complexity.scalability: Excellent - fastest gradient boosting for large data

comparisons.vsXGBoost: LightGBM faster and uses less memory; XGBoost has wider adoption
comparisons.vsCatBoost: CatBoost handles categoricals better; LightGBM faster on numeric data

uniqueFeatures.histogramOptimization: Discrete bins instead of continuous values
uniqueFeatures.efb: Reduce features by bundling exclusive ones

resources.paper: LightGBM: A Highly Efficient Gradient Boosting Decision Tree
